wholePhysicalScope: Mapped OpenStreetMap wall circuits, forts, the main gate, the palace and mosque courts, and 239 residential footprints on the original Terrarium sample frame.
lodDetails: Four levels retain the historic ramparts, white-roofed quarter, gate and minaret. Near levels retain individual footprints and refine the gateway, roof terraces and garden bastions.
limitations: Wall crown and bastion profiles, stair rises, house heights without level tags, roof treatments, and minaret position and height are estimated from the plan and photographs.
The individual residential footprints are retained in the two nearest levels. Nearby outlines are merged at longer ranges.

The field is unchanged, including offshore Terrarium outliers outside the fortified site. The garden beds and fountains follow mapped outlines or positions with schematic heights and plantings. The model omits building interiors.
